&reftitle.setup;
&reftitle.required;
PHP 8.2 or later is required by both the extension and the compatibility polyfill.
&reftitle.install;
The easiest way to install the extension is via PECL
pecl install ds
The extension can also be built directly from source:
# Dependencies you might need to install # sudo apt-get install git build-essential php-dev
git clone https://github.com/php-ds/ext-ds "php-ds" cd php-ds
# Build and install the extension phpize ./configure make make install
# Clean up the build files make clean phpize --clean
When using Composer, it is highly recommended to require php-ds/php-ds so that the code still works in an environment where the extension is not installed. The extension takes priority when it is installed.
